en-US.longDescription: The Microsoft Purview Information Protection client helps you classify and label data in your organization at the time of creation, as well as apply protection, based on encryption and usage rights for sensitive data. Labels, and protection are persistent, traveling with the data throughout its lifecycle, so that its detectable and controlled at all times  regardless of where its stored or with whom its shared  internally or externally.
